scope.summary: Idempotent Xero organisation to mapping destination bridge, backfill, navigation, and database assertions; no payroll submissions.
implemented: Database trigger maps authorized Xero tenant UUID into business-specific payroll destination without browser input.
Existing connected Xero tenant records backfill idempotently.
UI sends users through OAuth; existing employee mappings remain audited and manual.

evidence.outcome: Trigger and historic backfill committed, pending CI.

evidence.outcome: Requires new read scopes, employee lookup and explicit review.

decisions: No production DB writes or live Xero submissions until CI and owner approval.

Owner-approved payroll API entitlement and sample data verification.
